question: Which Indian musician was conferred with the Lifetime achievement Grammy Award?
solution:
The correct answer is** Pandit Ravi Shankar**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• Ravi Shankar KBE was an Indian sitarist and composer. A sitar virtuoso, he became the world's best-known exponent of North Indian classical music in the second half of the 20th century and influenced many musicians in India and throughout the world.
 
• He was born on 7 April 1920 in Varanasi and died on 11 December 2012 in La Jolla, California, United States.
